senses.gloss: पंक m.n. 1. Mud, dirt, clay, R.xvi.30, Bhartr.i.10, 2. a slough, a quagmire; 3. sin.
पंक-कीर m. a lapwing.
पंक-क्रीड m. a hog.
पंक-ग्राह m. a crocodile.
पंक-च्छिद् m. the clearing-nut tree.
पंक-ज n. a lotus.
पंक-ज˚ज, ˚जन्मन् m. an epithet of Brahman (m.).
पंक-ज˚ज, ˚जन्मन् m. an epithet of Brahman (m.).
पंक-ज˚नाभ m. an epithet of Viṣṇu, R.xviii.20.
पंकेज n. a lotus.
पंक-जन्मन् (I) n. a lotus.
पंक-जन्मन् (II) m. the sārasa bird.
पंक-जिनी f. 1. a place abounding with lotuses; 2. a lotus plant, Kir.x.33; 3. a group of lotuses; 4. the flexible stalk of a water-lily.
पंक-मंडुक m. a bivalve conch.
पंक-रुह्, -रुह n. a lotus.
पंक-रुह्, -रुह n. a lotus.
पंकेरुह (I) n. a lotus.
पंकेरुह (II) m. the sārasa bird.
पंक-वास m. a crab.
पंकेशय a. resting in mud.
पंकण m. The hut of a barbarian. Cf. पक्कण.
पंकार m. 1. Moss; 2. a dam, a dyke; 3. a flight of stairs, a ladder.
पंकिल (I) a. (f. ला) Muddy, clayey.
पंकिल (II) m. A boat.
पंकिल (I) a. (f. ला) Muddy, clayey.

पंक्ति f. 1. A row, a line, a series, अलिपंक्तिरनेकशस्त्वया गुणकृत्ये धनुषो नियोजिता K.S.iv.15; 2. a group, a troop, R.vi.5; 3. a row of people of the same caste sitting down to a meal (as in पंक्तिपावन), M.M.i.; 4. the earth; 5. fame, celebrity; 6. the number ‘ten’ (as in पंक्तिरथ).
पंक्ति-ग्रीव m. an epithet of Rāvaṇa.
पंक्ति-चर m. an osprey.
पंक्ति-दूष, -दूषक m. a person improper to be admitted to a caste-dinner.
पंक्ति-दूष, -दूषक m. a person improper to be admitted to a caste-dinner.

पंक्ति-पावन m. a respectable Brāhmaṇa who imparts sanctity to those who dine with him, or one who gets a seat of honour at dinner and other parties, or one who is learned in the Vedas, (1) यजुषां पारगो यस्तु साम्नां यश्चापि पारगः । अथर्वशिरसोऽध्येता ब्राह्मणः पंक्तिपावनः; (2) अपाङ्क्त्योपहता पंक्तिः पाव्यते यौर्द्विजोत्तमैः । तान्निबोधत कार्त्स्येन द्विजाग्र्यान् पंक्तिपावनान् M.iii.184. See the word used at M.M.i. and Jagaddhara’s explanations of it.
पंक्ति-रथ m. a name of Daśaratha.
पंगु (I) a. (f. गु or ग्वी) Lame, crippled.
पंगु (II) m. 1. A lame man, जडानंधान्पंगून्प्रकृतिबधिरानुक्तिविकलान् G.L.15; 2. an epithet of Saturn.
पंगु (I) a. (f. गु or ग्वी) Lame, crippled.
पंगु-ग्राह m. 1. a crocodile; 2. Capricornus, the tenth sign of the zodiac.
पंगुल a. (f. ला) Lame, crippled.
पंगुल a. (f. ला) Lame, crippled.

पंच् (I) vt. or vi. 1U (pp. पक्व; pres. पचति-ते; desid. पिपक्षति) (This is one of those roots which take two accusatives, e.g. तंडुलानोदनं पचति; but as such it is of rare occurrence.) 1. To cook, to bake, to roast, M.iii.118, Bhartr.i.85; 2. to bake or burn (as bricks); 3. to digest, प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम् Bg.xv.14; 4. to ripen, to mature; 5. to bring to perfection, to derelop; 6. (in the Atm.) to cook for oneself.With परि-, to mature, to develop.With वि-, 1. to mature, to ripen; 2. to digest; 3. to cook thoroughly.
पंच् (II) vt. 1Ā (pres. पचते) To make evident or clear.
पंच् (III) vt. 10U (pres. पंचयति-ते) To spread.
पंचक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Bought with five; 2. consisting of five; 3. made of five; 4. relating to five; 5. taking five per cent.
पंचक (II) m.n. An aggregate of five, e.g. यतिपंचकम्.
पंचक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Bought with five; 2. consisting of five; 3. made of five; 4. relating to five; 5. taking five per cent.
पंचत् f. A pentad, a collection of five.
पंचथु m. 1. Time; 2. the Indian cuckoo.
पंचन् num. (always pl.; nom. and acc. पंच) Five.(As the first member of compounds पंचन् drops it final न्.)
पंचन्-अंश m. the fifth part, a fifth.
पंचन्-अग्नि m. 1. the aggregate of the five sacred fires (viz., अन्वाहार्यपचन, गार्हपत्य, आहवनीय, सभ्य and आवसथ्य); 2. a householder who maintains these five sacred fires.
पंचन्-अंग (I) a. five membered, having five parts, e.g. पंचांगः प्रणामः.
पंचन्-अंग (II) m. 1. a turtle; 2. a species of horse with five spots on his body.
पंचन्-अंग (III) n. a calender, an almanack; (it is so called because it treats of five things- तिथिर्वारश्च नक्षत्रं योगः करणमेव च । पंचांगमेतदुद्दिष्टम्).
पंचन्-अंग˚गुप्त m. a turtle.
पंचन्-अंग˚शुद्धि f. the favourable state of five important points, viz., तिथि, वार, नक्षत्र, योग and करण (in astrology).
पंचन्-अंगी f. a bit for horses.
पंचन्-अंगुल a. (f. ला or ली) measuring five fingers.
पंचन्-अंगुल a. (f. ला or ली) measuring five fingers.
पंचन्-अंगुल a. (f. ला or ली) measuring five fingers.
पंचन्-अज n. the fire products of the goat.
पंचन्-अमृत n. an aggregate of five sweet things (दुग्धं च शर्करा चैव घृतं दधि तथा मधु । पंचामृतमिदं प्रोक्तम्).
पंचन्-अर्चिस् m. the planet Mercury.
पंचन्-अवयव a. five-membered (as a syllogism in Nyāya). For the five members of a syllogism, See न्याय 12.
पंचन्-अवस्थ m. a corpse; (so called because it is supposed to resolve into the five elements).
पंचन्-अविक n. the five products of the sheep.
पंचन्-अशीति f. eighty-five.
पंचन्-अह m. a period of five days.
पंचन्-आतप a. doing penance with four fires and the sun.

पंचन्-आनन, -आस्य, -मुख, -वक्त्र m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. (with the mouth wide open) a lion.(The word is used at the end of names of learned men to express veneration or high scholarship, e.g. जगन्नाथतर्कपंचानन.)

पंचन्-आनन, -आस्य, -मुख, -वक्त्र m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. (with the mouth wide open) a lion.(The word is used at the end of names of learned men to express veneration or high scholarship, e.g. जगन्नाथतर्कपंचानन.)

पंचन्-आनन, -आस्य, -मुख, -वक्त्र m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. (with the mouth wide open) a lion.(The word is used at the end of names of learned men to express veneration or high scholarship, e.g. जगन्नाथतर्कपंचानन.)

पंचन्-आनन, -आस्य, -मुख, -वक्त्र m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. (with the mouth wide open) a lion.(The word is used at the end of names of learned men to express veneration or high scholarship, e.g. जगन्नाथतर्कपंचानन.)
पंचन्-इंद्रिय n. the aggregate of the five organs of sense or of action. (See इंद्रिय.)
पंचन्-इषु m. an epithet of the god of love, यावज्ज्वलति नांगेषु स्वतः पंचेषुपावकः Bhartr.i.62. (For the five arrows of the god of love, See under अरविंद.
पंचन्-उष्मन् m. pl. the five digestive fires supposed to be in the body.

पंचन्-कर्मन् n. five kinds of treatment, viz., (1) वमन ‘giving emetics,’ (2) रेचन ‘purging,’ (3) नस्य ‘giving sternutatories,’ (4) निरूह ‘administering an enema not oily,’ (5) अनुवासन ‘administering an oily enema’ (in medicine).
पंचन्-कृत्वस् ind. five times.
पंचन्-कोण n. a pentagon.
पंचन्-कोल n. the five spices collectively.
पंचन्-कोष m. pl. the five sheaths supposed to envelop the soul (in Vedānta phil.).
पंचन्-क्रोशी f. a distance of five kośs.
पंचन्-खट्व n. five beds collectively.
पंचन्-खट्वी f. five beds collectively.
पंचन्-गव n. a collection of five cows.
पंचन्-गव्य n. five products of the cow (collectively); (they are मूत्र, गोमय, क्षीर, दधि and आज्य).
पंचन्-गु a. bought with five cows.
पंचन्-गुण a. fivefold.
पंचन्-गुप्त m. 1. a turtle; 2. the atheistic system of the Chārvākas.
पंचन्-चत्वारिंश a. forty-fifth.
पंचन्-चत्वारिंशत् f. forty-five.
पंचन्-जन (I) m. man, mankind.
पंचन्-जन (II) m. pl. 1. the five classes of beings, viz., gods, men, gandharvas, serpents and pitṛs; 2. the four primary castes of the Hindus together with the Nishādas (barbarians).
पंचन्-जनीन m. a mimic, a buffoon.
पंचन्-ज्ञान m. 1. an epithet of Buddha; 2. a man conversant with the doctrines of the Pāśupatas.
पंचन्-तक्ष n. a group of five carpenters.
पंचन्-तक्षी f. a group of five carpenters.

पंचन्-तत्व m.n. 1. the five elements collectively (viz., पृथ्वी, अप्, तेजस्, वायु and आकाश); 2. the five essentials of the Tāntrikas, otherwise called the five makāras, viz., मद्य, मांस, मत्स्य, मुद्रा and मैथुन) (in the Tantras).
पंचन्-तपस् m. an ascetic who sits between four fires with the burning sun above in the hot weather, M.vi.23, Sis.ii.51.
पंचन्-ता f. 1. fivefold state; 2. the five elements collectively.(पंचता or पंचत्वं गम् ‘to separate into the five elements, i.e. to die’; पंचता or पंचत्वं नी or प्रापय् ‘to kill.’)
पंचन्-त्व n. 1. fivefold state; 2. the five elements collectively.(पंचता or पंचत्वं गम् ‘to separate into the five elements, i.e. to die’; पंचता or पंचत्वं नी or प्रापय् ‘to kill.’)
पंचन्-तय (I) a. fivefold.
पंचन्-तय (II) n. a pentad.
पंचन्-त्रिंश a. the thirty-fifth.
पंचन्-त्रिंशत्, त्रिंशति f. thirty-five.
पंचन्-त्रिंशत्, त्रिंशति f. thirty-five.
पंचन्-दश a. 1. the fifteenth; 2. increased by fifteen, (e.g. पंचदश शतम् ‘one hundred and fifteen’).
पांचदश a. (f. शी) Relating to the fifteenth day of a month.
पंचन्-दशन् a. pl. fifteen.
पंचन्-दशन्˚अह m. a period of fifteen days.
पंचन्-दशिन् a. consisting of fifteen.
पंचन्-दशी f. the fifteenth day of a lunar fortnight.
पांचदश a. (f. शी) Relating to the fifteenth day of a month.
पंचन्-दीर्घ n. the five long parts of the body.
पंचन्-धा ind. in five ways, in five parts.
पंचन्-नख m. 1. any animal having five claws, M.v.17; 2. an elephant; 3. a turtle; 4. a lion, a tiger.
पंचन्-नद (I) m. the country of five rivers, i.e. the Panjab; (the five rivers are शतद्रु, विपाशा, इरावती, चंद्रभागा and वितस्ता).
पंचन्-नद (II) m. pl. the people of this country.
पंचन्-नवति f. ninety-five.
पंचन्-नीराजन n. waving five things before an idol; (the five things are a lamp, lotus, cloth, mango and betel-leaf).
पंचन्-पंचाश a. the fifty-fifth.
पंचन्-पंचाशत् f. fifty-five.
पंचन्-पात्र n. 1. five vessels collectively; 2. a śrāddha in which offerings are made in vessels.
पंचन्-प्राण m. pl. the five vital airs, viz., प्राण, अपान, व्यान, उदान and समान.
पंचन्-प्रसाद m. a temple of a particular size.
पंचन्-बाण, -वाण, -शर m. an epithet of the god of love, K.S.vii.92. See पंचेषु.
पंचन्-बाण, -वाण, -शर m. an epithet of the god of love, K.S.vii.92. See पंचेषु.
पंचन्-बाण, -वाण, -शर m. an epithet of the god of love, K.S.vii.92. See पंचेषु.
पंचन्-भूत m.n. the five elements, viz., पृथ्वी, अप्, तेजस्, वायु and आकाश.
पंचन्-मकार n. the five essentials of the left-hand Tantra ritual. See पंचतत्व (2).
पंचन्-महापातक n. the five great sins; (they are- ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं स्तेयं गुर्वंगनागमः । महांति पातकान्याहुः संसर्गश्चापि तैस्सह).
पंचन्-महायज्ञ n. pl. five daily sacrifices. (See महायज्ञ.)
पंचन्-याम m. a day.

पंचन्-रत्न n. a collection of live gems. (They are variously enumerated- (1) नीलकं वज्रकं चेति पद्मरागश्च मौक्तिकम् । प्रवालं चेति विज्ञेयं पंचरत्नं मनीषिभिः; (2) सुवर्णं रजतं मुक्ता राजावर्तं प्रवालकम् । रत्नपंचकमाख्यातम्; (3) कनकं हरिकं नीलं पद्मरागश्च मौक्तिकम् । पंचरत्नमिदं प्रोक्तम्.)
पंचन्-रात्र n. a period of five nights.
पंचन्-राशिक n. the rule of five (in math.).
पंचन्-लक्षण n. a Purāṇa. (See under पुराण.)
पंचन्-लवण n. five kinds of salt. viz., काचक, सैंधव, सामुद्र, विड and सौवर्चल.
पंचन्-वटी f. 1. the five fig trees, viz., अश्वत्थ, बिल्व, वट, धात्री and अशोक; 2. name of a part of the Danḍaka forest where the Godāvarī rises, R.xii.31, xviii.34.
पंचन्-वर्षदेशीय a. nearly five years old.
पंचन्-वर्षीय a. five years old.
पंचन्-वल्कल n. a collection of the bark of five kinds of trees (viz., न्यग्रोध, उदुंबर, अश्वत्थ, प्लक्ष and वेतस).
पंचन्-विंश a. the twenty-fifth.
पंचन्-विंशति f. twenty-five.
पंचन्-विंशतिका f. a collection of twenty-five, e.g. वेतालपंचविंशतिका.
पंचन्-विध a. five-fold, of five kinds.
पंचन्-शत (I) a. amounting to five hundred.
पंचन्-शत (II) n. 1. one hundred and five; 2. five hundred.
पंचन्-शस् ind. five by five.
पंचन्-शाख m. 1. the hand; 2. an elephant.
पंचन्-शिख m. a lion.
पंचन्-ष a. pl. five or six, अयं च कुसुमायुधप्रियसुहृत् क्षणैः पंचषैर्भविष्यति पयोनिधेः पुलिनराजहंसः शशी Vikr.Ch.xi.74, Bhartr.ii.34.
पंचाश a. (f. शी) The fiftieth.
पंचन्-षष्ट a. the sixty-fifth.
पंचन्-षष्टि f. sixty-five.
पंचन्-सप्तत a. the seventy-fifth.
पंचन्-सप्तति f. seventy-five.

पंचन्-सूना f. the five things in a house which may accidentally destroy animal life, and for the atonement of which देवयज्ञ is required to be performed every day; (they are- पंचसूना गृहस्थस्य चुल्लांपेषण्युपस्करः । कडनी चोदकुंभश्च M.iii.68).
पंचन्-हायन a. five years old.
पंचनी f. A chequered cloth for playing at draughts.
पंचम (I) a. (f. मी) 1. The fifth; 2. dexterous, clever; 3. beautiful, brilliant.

पंचम (II) m. 1. The fifth note of the Hindu musical scale; (the Indian cuckoo is supposed to utter this note in cooing); 2. the name of a rāga or musical mode, गोपवधूरनुगायति काचिदुदंचितपंचमरागम् Git.G.i.
पंचम (III) n. 1. A fifth; 2. sexual intercourse.
पंचम (I) a. (f. मी) 1. The fifth; 2. dexterous, clever; 3. beautiful, brilliant.
पंचमी f. 1. The fifth day of a lunar fortnight; 2. the ablative case (in gram.); 3. an epithet of Draupadī; 4. a chequered board for playing at draughts.
पंचम-आस्य m. the Indian cuckoo.
पंचाल (I) m. pl. Name of a country and its people.
पंचाल (II) m. A king of the Pānchālas.
पांचाल (I) a. (f. ली) Belonging to the Pānchālas.
पांचाल (II) m. 1. The country of the Pānchālas; 2. a prince of that country.
पांचाल (III) m. pl. The people of that country.
पंचालिका f. A doll, a puppet. Cf. पांचालिका.
पांचालिका f. A doll, a puppet, स्तन्यत्यागात्प्रभृति सुमुखी दंतपांचालिकेव क्रीडायोगं तदनु विनयं प्रापिता वर्धिता च M.M.x.
पंचाली f. 1. A doll, a puppet; 2. a kind of song; 3. chequered board for playing at draughts.
पांचाल (I) a. (f. ली) Belonging to the Pānchālas.

पांचाली f. 1. A woman of the Pānchālas; 2. a name of Draupadī, the wife of the Pāṇḍavas; 3. a doll, a puppet; 4. a particular style of composition (in rhetoric) [thus defined in S.D.- वर्णैः शेषैः (i.e. other than माधुर्यव्यंजक and ओजःप्रकाशक) पुनर्द्वयोः । समस्तपंचषपदो बंधः पांचालिका मता].
पंचाश a. (f. शी) The fiftieth.
पंचाशत् f. Fifty.
पंचाशत् f. Fifty.
पंचाशिका f. 1. A collection of fifty; 2. a collection of fifty stanzas, e.g. चौरपंचाशिका.
पंजर (I) n. A cage, an aviary, Bh.V.i.58, R.v.74.
पंजर (II) m.n. A skeleton.
पंजर (III) m. 1. The body; 2. the Kaliyuga.
पंजर-आखेट m. a sort of trap for catching fish.
पंजर-शुक m. a caged parrot.
पंजि f. 1. The ball of cotton from which thread is spun; 2. record, a journal.
पंजि f. 1. The ball of cotton from which thread is spun; 2. record, a journal.
पंजि-कारक m. a scribe.
पंजि-कारक m. a scribe.
पंड m. A eunuch.
पंडा f. 1. Wisdom, understanding; 2. learning.
पंडा-वत् m. a learned man, Asv.6.
